craft_notes: Sthāyin: warrant — triple precedent plus seal. Rows: lineage then verdict. Read aloud: cited thunder.

lines: Through Jewel-Garland, Three-Peak, Perfect Lore the thread comes law-first, crowned with the Highest's bid —
and the Light-Hall declares: threadless, all is fruitless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa ca śrīratnamālātriśiromataśrīsiddhāmatādau vidhipūrvakaḥ pārameśvarājñāpūrakaś ca uktaṃ caitat śrītantrāloke vinā pavitrakeṇa sarvaṃ niṣphalam iti
